Name: Chest Swap - Nearby Chest Switching
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[quote][center][color=#8e7cc3][size=5][font=Arial Black][b]About Mod[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote]Tired of closing one chest just to open another nearby?
[color=#8e7cc3][b]Chest Swap[/b][/color] makes storage management smoother by letting you switch between nearby chests directly from the chest interface.
Use the on-screen navigation arrows to move between nearby chests without repeatedly closing and reopening them.
Simple, convenient, and designed to make everyday storage management a little less tedious.
[img width=554]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55669/55669-1794939647-1882119333.png[/img]
[quote][center][b][color=#8e7cc3][size=5][font=Arial Black]Features[/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]
[/quote][list]
[*]Switch between nearby chests using on-screen navigation arrows.[/*]
[*]Navigate left and right through nearby chests.[/*]
[*]Seamless navigation without repeatedly closing the chest interface.[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu integration.[/*]
[/list][quote][center][b][color=#93c47d][size=5][font=Arial Black]💚Bug Fixes & Thanks💚[/font][/size][/color][/b] [/center]
[/quote]Check the Changelog for the latest fixes and improvements. Thanks to everyone who uses [b][color=#93c47d]Chest Swap[/color][/b], reports bugs, and shares feedback. Your support means a lot!
[quote][center][b][color=#ff7700][size=5][font=Arial Black]Installation[/font][/size][/color][/b] [/center]
[/quote][heading]How?[/heading]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Install SMAPI (version 4.0.0 or later)[/color][/b] if you haven't already.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Download Chest Swap[/color][/b] and extract the downloaded ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Move the
[code]ChestSwap[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through [color=#ff7700][b]SMAPI[/b].[/color][/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url] to configure [color=#ff7700][b]Chest Swap[/b][/color] directly in-game.[/*]
[/list]That's it! [b][color=#ff7700]Chest Swap[/color][/b] is ready to use.
[b]Note:[/b] Make sure the folder structure looks like this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── ChestSwap/
        ├── i18n/
        ├── ChestSwap.dll
        └── manifest.json[/code][code]Want to check out another one of my mods? Give this one a try!
